messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PrivateLink euc1 - 30m spike in 502s and connection failures for private endpoints (customers: FinWave, DataHarbor). Error rate: 18% -> paging oncall.
Maya (oncall-sre): I see pager. Investigating now. Any customer-facing alerts yet? @Elena can you ping FinWave contact?
Rajat (networking): FYI we're seeing BGP withdraws from provider peer in eu-central-1 around 3125999880 -> repeated A->B path flaps. I have BGP dumps coming.
Maya (oncall-sre): Noted. Tracing a customer endpoint (FinWave privatelink VIP) now. Short traces show packet loss hitting our egress AZ b.
Elena (solutions-eng): FinWave says some API requests started failing ~11:20 UTC, retries eventually succeed. They're on a maintained SLA route; they're looking for a temporary workaround.
Maya (oncall-sre): Can you drop the traceroute output here, Rajat? Share the AS path snippet.
Rajat (networking): Pasting trimmed output:
```
> show bgp neighbors 203.0.113.2 routes
* 203.0.113.2   65001 65003 65099
  203.0.113.2   65001 65100 65099  (withdrawn then re-announced)
```
Also seeing more than usual route churn to our euc1-az-b compute fabric.
Tom (customer-ops): DataHarbor reports failed connections to storage via privatelink (timeouts), they temporarily switched to public peering and are degrading gracefully.
Maya (oncall-sre): Action list: 1) Confirm whether this is localized to AZ-b. 2) If so, shift PrivateLink traffic away from AZ-b to AZ-a via route preference. 3) Notify customers. 4) Escalate to cloud provider NOC for their peer oscillation.
Rajat (networking): Confirmed localized: telemetry shows >90% of affected sessions egress through az-b transit routers. I can push a route preference to prefer az-a for the affected prefixes (temporary). Will do a controlled change with 30s observation window.
Logan (sre-lead): +1 for prefer-az-a. Avoid mass BGP flaps. Use community tag + local-pref change, not withdraw.
Maya (oncall-sre): Go for it, Rajat. Post the exact command you run (so we can rollback).
Rajat (networking): Command (edge orchestration CLI):
```
edge-route update --prefix 10.11.0.0/16 --prefer az-a --community 65010:300 --ttl 60
```
Applying in 15s.
Maya (oncall-sre): Applying now. Watching graphs.
incident-bot: [INFO] Route update queued by Rajat at 3126000055
Rajat (networking): Done. Local-pref bumped for the prefix to prefer az-a. Monitoring BGP adjacencies.
Maya (oncall-sre): Early signs: 50% drop in 502 rate in the next 45s. FinWave responding to webhook retries. Keeping watch for 5m.
Elena (solutions-eng): I told FinWave to route new connections via their fallback and increase retry window. They appreciate the transparency.
Tom (customer-ops): DataHarbor confirmed reduced timeouts after they flushed sockets and retried. Good sign.
Rajat (networking): Provider NOC responded: seeing an internal fabric issue in their eu-central-1 AZ-b interconnect that correlates with our timestamps. They're targeting a repair in ~30–45m. We should keep preference on az-a till they confirm stable.
Maya (oncall-sre): Agreed. I'll mark this incident as "mitigated" for customer impact but still in-progress until provider confirms stable. Notifying outage channel and customers now.
Maya (oncall-sre): Quick incident summary for customers: short-lived PrivateLink connectivity degradation in eu-central-1 centered on AZ-b caused intermittent 502s/timeouts. We pref routed traffic to AZ-a to restore connectivity. Provider working on underlying fabric.
Logan (sre-lead): Good. Please record RCA placeholders and collect BGP dump, route-change logs, and all timings for postmortem.
Maya (oncall-sre): Will do. Handing off to next oncall in 15m — @Logan will be lead if things reflare. Actions for handoff: keep az-a preference, watch 502 rate, validate provider repair message.
Logan (sre-lead): I'll take it. If provider posts stable, we'll gradually revert preference in controlled steps with a long observation window.
incident-bot: [RESOLVE NOTICE] Incident marked mitigated by Maya at 3126000180 (customer impact reduced). Follow-up: create incident ticket and postmortem link.
Maya (oncall-sre): Filing ticket and postmortem draft now. Tagging networking and solutions. Thanks all for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
Elena (solutions-eng): I'll follow up with FinWave and DataHarbor with timeline and workaround notes.
Rajat (networking): Saving BGP dumps to /prod/incidents/3126000000/bgp-dumps.tar.gz and route-change audit to the ticket. Will add provider NOC message thread.
Tom (customer-ops): Closing loop with DataHarbor on their end; they want to do a short DR test later today to validate failover behaviour.
Maya (oncall-sre): End of thread — next steps: postmortem, RCA on why route preference was necessary, consider automated az fallback for PrivateLink prefixes.
